description: Sample JSON requests for testing configurable backup frequency feature
note: The system automatically calculates the backup period based on the frequency configuration in application.yml

1_monthly_full_backup.description: Full backup request for MONTHLY frequency (March 2026)

expected_database_record.note: backup_month stores the calculated period in YYYY-MM format

2_monthly_incremental_backup.description: Incremental backup request for MONTHLY frequency (March 15, 2026)

expected_behavior.query_executed: SELECT base_backup_uuid FROM full_backup_tracker WHERE backup_month = '2026-03'

3_weekly_full_backup.description: Full backup request for WEEKLY frequency (Monday, March 9, 2026 - Week 11)

expected_database_record.note: backup_month stores the calculated period in YYYY-Www format (ISO week)

4_weekly_incremental_backup.description: Incremental backup request for WEEKLY frequency (Thursday, March 12, 2026 - Week 11)

expected_behavior.query_executed: SELECT base_backup_uuid FROM full_backup_tracker WHERE backup_month = '2026-W11'

5_weekly_new_week_full_backup.description: Full backup request for WEEKLY frequency (Monday, March 16, 2026 - Week 12 - NEW WEEK)

expected_database_record.note: NEW period 2026-W12 - creates a NEW full backup for the new week

6_custom_10day_full_backup.description: Full backup request for CUSTOM frequency (March 11, 2026 - Start of 10-day interval)

expected_database_record.note: backup_month stores the calculated period in YYYY-MM-DD format (interval start date)

7_custom_10day_incremental_backup.description: Incremental backup request for CUSTOM frequency (March 15, 2026 - Within 10-day interval)

expected_behavior.calculation_logic: March 15 falls in days 71-80 interval (starting from 2026-01-01 epoch)
expected_behavior.query_executed: SELECT base_backup_uuid FROM full_backup_tracker WHERE backup_month = '2026-03-11'

8_custom_10day_new_interval_full_backup.description: Full backup request for CUSTOM frequency (March 21, 2026 - NEW 10-day interval)

expected_database_record.note: NEW period 2026-03-21 - creates a NEW full backup for the new 10-day interval
